description:
Problem: make pr-open always targets develop, so upper stacked drafts are opened with 'gh pr create --draft --base <parent>' (docs/internal/pr-base-branch-policy.md:9) and skip the local oracle review; the same doc (:128) says ordinary PRs may also use gh pr create, the route #3537 took after make pr-open refused.

Outcome (owner decision 2026-10-26): make pr-open accepts a parent option for upper drafts. It verifies the parent is an open same-repository PR branch within the stack depth limit, runs the local review against the parent as base, pushes the reviewed SHA and opens a draft against the parent. Docs drop gh pr create entirely: make pr-open is the only creation path.

Decision gates:
1. The parent must be an open PR branch in this repository whose stack depth stays at most 3; anything else refuses.
2. The reviewed diff is the upper PR's own diff (merge base with the parent); prove it with a test.
3. AGENTS.md stacking text stays unchanged unless it contradicts the result; if it must change, stop and ask with wording and byte count.
